algebra.interpretation: Nearly two hundred concentric circles are replaced by long radial spline normals. Their common center persists, but the discrete 39-sample phase and neighboring radii accumulate into a dense monochrome diffraction disk.
algebra.order: Read operators right to left; tool flow arrays execute top to bottom. P changes paint, C changes shape, K maps colors, H creates concentric scale copies, N samples normal marks, B samples tangent or vertical marks, T is a small affine transform.
